description.value: A Sri Lankan restaurant on Knight Street in Vancouver serving traditional dishes including rice and curry, hoppers, coconut sambol, and spicy seafood. The menu emphasises aromatic curries made with quality ingredients and traditional cooking techniques, with notable vegetarian options. It operates as a sit-down neighbourhood restaurant and is positioned as a destination for authentic Sri Lankan cuisine in the city.
